PS Plus monthly games for November 2026

Free to claim now: November's games

Claim these by Monday 30 November 2026 (7 days left). Once claimed, they're yours to play for as long as you're a PS Plus member, on any tier. Adding them to your library is enough; you don't need to download them.

  • Dead Island 2

    PS4 and PS5 · Metascore 73 · about 16 h main story

    Like its predecessor, Dead Island 2 is an action role-playing game played from a first-person perspective. While players can play the game solo, it also supports three-player cooperative multiplayer.

    Find it on the wall

  • Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered

    PS4 and PS5 · Metascore 70 · about 28 h main story

    Like the previous Tomb Raider titles, each game features archaeologist-adventurer Lara Croft exploring a majority of locations in search of ancient artifacts, and is presented from a third-person perspective.

    Find it on the wall

  • Monster Train 2

    PS5 · Metascore 87 · about 5.3 h main story

    Find it on the wall

Sony usually announces the next month's games on the last Wednesday before they arrive, so expect December's lineup on Wednesday 25 November 2026, free to claim from Tuesday 1 December 2026. This page updates the same day.
